import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, Typography, Box, Stack, Chip, LinearProgress } from '@mui/material';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import AutoAwesomeRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeRounded';

function AiInsightsCard() {
  return (
    <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}>
      <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid rgba(14,165,233,0.35)', boxShadow: '0 0 30px rgba(14,165,233,0.2)' }}>
        <Box sx={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(37,99,235,0.3), transparent 45%)' }} />
        <CardContent sx={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center" mb={2}>
            <Box sx={{ color: '#7DD3FC', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <AutoAwesomeRoundedIcon />
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="h6">AI Quality Insights</Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" mb={2}>The platform detected a likely dependency bottleneck in payment gateway retries and recommends proactive mitigation before the next release window.</Typography>
          <Stack spacing={1.5}>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2">Root Cause Summary</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2">Timeout jitter and retry storm are creating intermittent checkout failures.</Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2">Top Recommendation</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2">Introduce exponential backoff and circuit breaker thresholds.</Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2">Release Readiness</Typography>
              <LinearProgress variant="determinate" value={82} sx={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 999, bgcolor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', '& .MuiLinearProgress-bar': { bgcolor: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22C55E, #0EA5E9)' } }} />
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export default AiInsightsCard;
